question: Should Crabline preserve the existing recorderPath and directory-ownership upgrade behavior, or intentionally make these fail-closed breaking changes in this release?
rationale: The patch strengthens persistence and security but changes existing artifact consumers and can stop upgraded installations; repository intent is needed to choose the supported compatibility contract.

options.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
options.body: Keep recorderPath stable, add a separate versioned snapshot field, and provide migration or opt-in strict ownership enforcement before merging.

options.title: Approve the breaking hardening
options.body: Accept the fail-closed ownership and recorderPath changes with explicit upgrade documentation and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Split the compatibility changes
options.body: Land internal recorder and durability fixes separately while deferring the ownership and artifact-contract changes for focused review.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgrade compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep recorderPath stable, add a separate versioned snapshot field, and provide migration or opt-in strict ownership enforcement before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member carrying the affected security and persistence work and are the clearest available owner for the intended compatibility boundary.
